note: Section 4.4.1: "Every SPD SHOULD have a nominal, final entry that matches anything that is otherwise unmatched, and discards it." Re-judged 2026-11-12 (independent auditor) because apply.go::applyConfig changed: the one hunk adds warnICMPOverlapAtStart(cfg, s.log) beside warnImplicitDiscardAtStart in the applyStartup branch and widens its comment. warnICMPOverlapAtStart (icmp_overlap.go) only logs each refusal icmpOverlapRefusals answers; it and both refusal functions read cfg and write nothing, so no SPD entry, ranking or disposition moved, and the call sits after the node catch-all, guard, IKE bypass, interface entries and prune, with no new return path. Tagged units are byte-identical to the previous judgement and ./le rfc check names applyConfig alone, raising no record complaint for this id. Tested: "a nominal, final entry that matches anything that is otherwise unmatched, and discards it", in the XFRM SPDs the IKE engine owns. Node-wide if_id 0 SPD: TestRFC4301DefaultFinalSPDEntryDiscards (installUnmatched builds in/out/fwd wildcard DISCARD at PriorityUnmatched by default), TestRFC4301FinalEntryIsUnderEveryZeSPDEntry (every write replayed, catch-all present and DISCARD whenever another Ze entry is live), negative TestRFC4301InboundClearPacketIsDiscardedByTheDefaultFinalEntry (kernel XfrmInPolBlock +1, packet not delivered). Per-interface if_id SPDs: TestInterfaceSPDCatchAllEntries (interfaceSPDCatchAll: DISCARD at the if_id, below PriorityChildSA, unnarrowed), TestApplyInstallsInterfaceSPDCatchAllAndGuard (applyConfig on applyReload, so the new startup-only call is not on its path; asserts the exact interface catch-all set, five exemptions, node catch-all DISCARD and the guard), TestReleaseRemovesInterfaceSPDAndGuard, TestRFC4301InterfaceSPDDiscardsUnmatchedInKernel (XfrmOutPolBlock rises at the if_id, Child SA policy outranks it), negative TestInterfaceSPDCatchAllInstallFailureFailsTheApply. They assert the exact DISCARD action and ranking, not a floor. Each cover carries a discrimination record (xfrmPolicyAction BLOCK->ALLOW, parseUnmatched disabled, shutdown releaseSPD-before-stop, planXFRMInterfaceEntries catchAll[:0], interfaceSPDCatchAll DISCARD->BYPASS, installXFRMInterfaceEntries noFinalEntry dropped, releaseSPD warnSPDLeft && false); none breaks applyConfig, so the edit stales none, and the releaseSPD record the previous note called owed is now present. Gap: "Every SPD". Accurate at the producers: internal/component/ike/dataplane/vpp_policy.go::vppPolicyInterface refuses IfIndex <= 0 and vppBackend.CatchAllSupported answers ErrNoNodeWideSPD, so no VPP SPD gets a final entry; defaultDataplaneSource plus buildIPsecPolicies install the OSPFv3 proto-89 transport entries with no final entry of their own, in force with no vpn ipsec block and after releaseSPD. {partial} annotation accurate; the whole requirement remains unproven.
